claim: "31 town pages with no page titles" (standfirst and section 1 heading) and "all 32 pages have an empty title"
problem: I could only find 30 town pages. The homepage navigation/footer exposes exactly 30 distinct /electrician/<town> URLs (cranbury, dayton, east-brunswick, east-windsor, edison, fords, franklin-park, helmetta, highland-park, jamesburg, kendall-park, kingston, manalapan, matawan, metuchen, millstone, milltown, monmouth-junction, monroe, monroe-township, new-brunswick, north-brunswick, old-bridge, parlin, princeton, sayreville, somerset, south-brunswick, south-river, spotswood), and unlisted towns I tested (/electrician/robbinsville, /electrician/plainsboro) return a "CITY PAGE NOT FOUND" view. Homepage + 30 town pages = 31 pages, not 32. The empty-title finding itself is correct; the counts are off by one.
fix: Change to "30 town pages" and "all 31 pages" (or re-crawl, list the URLs and state the exact count you observed).

claim: "four master licences on the page" and "structured data with the four licences"
problem: The site publishes three master licences (NJ Master Electrician #9674, NJ Master HVAC #4711, NJ Master HVAC #6091) plus a Home Improvement Contractor registration (#13VH02466500). The HIC registration is not a master licence, so "four master licences" overstates the credentials.
fix: Say "three master licences and an NJ home-improvement registration" or "four published credentials/licence numbers".

problem: The cited Birdeye profile shows Mon–Thu 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. but Friday 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m., closed Saturday and Sunday. The single "Mon–Fri ... 4:30" range is not what the cited source says.
fix: "published hours are Mon–Thu 8:00–4:30 and Fri 8:00–4:00, closed weekends (per Birdeye)", or cite a source that actually shows 4:30 on Friday.

problem: Toby is a published first-name mailbox (toby@hollanderelectric.com) and is named in reviews, but nothing public establishes that Toby is the founder/owner. Google reviews name "Steve Hollander" as the person a long-standing customer's family called, so the addressee's role is an unverified inference presented as fact.
fix: Confirm who the owner/founder is before sending, or drop the founder framing ("Hi Toby" alone) and keep the personalise-before-sending note.
